A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the ADCC of peripheral blood leukocytes is an indicator of the state of immune competence of the host and that the ADCC assay can be used as a criterion in assessing the immune competence of groups or individuals.

ADCC is a useful parameter to monitor immune competence of cancer patients and that the use of ADCC in the evaluation of the immune status of cancer patients may prove to be of clinical importance.   1.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ADCC can be used as a simple, inexpensive, and effective tool in the assessment of immune competence of cancer patients.
the use of ADCC as a measure of immune competence is a valuable tool to assess the effectiveness of treatment in cancer patients and to evaluate the immune status of noncancer patients.
the immune competence of cancer patients can be restored by appropriate treatment.
